title: Event Alerts Integration
description: A plugin to integrate your server with the Event Alerts ecosystem
body:
# Event Alerts Integration
A plugin that alerts you when a Minecraft event happens and offers other integrations with the Event Alerts ecosystem

Check out [eventalerts.gg](https://eventalerts.gg) and Join the [Event Alerts Discord](https://eventalerts.gg/discord) to learn more!

**🐛 Bugs / 💡 Suggestions:** Please [open an issue](https://github.com/srnyx/limited-lives/issues/new/choose) to report a bug or suggest an idea

**🆘 Support:** Please [join the development Discord](https://eventalerts.gg/development) to get support

## Features
- Configurable (with filters) in-game notifications for events:
  - Skeppy events
  - Famous events (Karl, MrBeast, etc...)
  - Money events ($5+ USD)
  - Hypixel events
  - Civilization events
  - And more!
- Teleport button to take you to an event's server
- Require players to have a linked Event Alerts account to join your server
  - Use commands such as `/ea linking discord <player>` to get the Discord account of the specified player
- Prevent cross-banned (from Event Alerts) players from joining your server

## Wiki

For all information about the plugin (commands, permissions, etc.) please see the wiki at [github.com/Event-Alerts/event-alerts-integration/wiki](https://github.com/Event-Alerts/event-alerts-integration/wiki)

## Download

**✅ Stable:** You can download the latest **stable** version here

**🚧 Snapshot:** You can download the latest **snapshot** version at [github.com/Event-Alerts/event-alerts-integration/actions/workflows/build.yml](https://github.com/Event-Alerts/event-alerts-integration/actions/workflows/build.yml)
